content: The guideline image illustrates the anatomy of the aorta and its main branches, including the right and left common carotid arteries, right and left subclavian arteries, innominate (brachiocephalic) artery, ascending thoracic aorta, aortic arch, descending thoracic aorta, aortic root (sinuses of Valsalva), sinotubular junction, aortic annulus, diaphragm, suprarenal abdominal aorta, superior mesenteric artery, celiac axis, right and left renal arteries, inferior mesenteric artery, right and left common iliac arteries, and the abdominal aorta. The diagram is part of the 2022 ACC/AHA aortic disease guideline focusing on aortic anatomy.
